Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brings mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city centre serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as your work, projects or interests, plus a bit of structure and visuals to make it more engaging.

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. The personal tone and mentioning your love of hiking make it friendly. To improve it, you could add posts with trail stories and photos, and some navigation or categories so readers can find content easily.
